title: 第35课 · 快要考试了
subtitle: Lesson 35 — 快要考试了 · The exam is coming soon

items.zh: 快要考试了，你准备好了吗？
items.py: Kuài yào kǎoshì le, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
items.en: The exam is coming, are you ready?

items.py: Wǒ yībiān tīng lùyīn yībiān xiě.
items.en: I write while listening to the recording.

items.zh: 除了语法以外，别的都复习了。
items.py: Chúle yǔfǎ yǐwài, bié de dōu fùxí le.
items.en: I've reviewed everything except grammar.

items.py: Zhǐyào nǔlì jiù néng kǎo hǎo.
items.en: As long as you work hard, you can do well.

items.py: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ bú pà.
items.en: Although it's hard, I'm not afraid.

items.zh: 和子：快要考试了，你准备好了吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Kuài yào kǎoshì le, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
items.en: Hezi: The exam is coming, are you ready?

items.zh: 大卫：还没有呢。除了语法以外，别的都复习了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hái méiyǒu ne. Chúle yǔfǎ yǐwài, bié de dōu fùxí le.
items.en: David: Not yet. I've reviewed everything except grammar.

items.py: Hézǐ: Yǔfǎ quèshí bǐjiào nán.
items.en: Hezi: Grammar is indeed harder.

items.zh: 大卫：虽然很难，但是我不怕。只要努力就能考好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ bú pà. Zhǐyào nǔlì jiù néng kǎo hǎo.
items.en: David: Although it's hard, I'm not afraid. Work hard and I'll do fine.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ měi tiān zěnme fùxí?
items.en: Hezi: How do you review every day?

items.zh: 大卫：我一边听录音一边写，效果不错。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ yībiān tīng lùyīn yībiān xiě, xiàoguǒ búcuò.
items.en: David: I write while listening to recordings, it works well.

items.zh: 玛丽：张老师，怎么才能学好汉语？
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhāng lǎoshī, zěnme cái néng xué hǎo Hànyǔ?
items.en: Mary: Teacher Zhang, how can I learn Chinese well?

items.zh: 张老师：最重要的是多说多练。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Zuì zhòngyào de shì duō shuō duō liàn.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: The most important thing is to speak and practice more.

items.py: Mǎlì: Kěshì wǒ pà shuō cuò.
items.en: Mary: But I'm afraid of making mistakes.

items.zh: 张老师：不要怕说错。说错了不要紧，可以慢慢改。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Bú yào pà shuō cuò. Shuō cuò le bú yàojǐn, kěyǐ mànman gǎi.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Don't be afraid of mistakes. It's OK, you can correct them gradually.

items.zh: 玛丽：除了说以外，还要做什么？
items.py: Mǎlì: Chúle shuō yǐwài, hái yào zuò shénme?
items.en: Mary: Besides speaking, what else should I do?

items.zh: 张老师：多看中文电视，多听中文歌。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Duō kàn Zhōngwén diànshì, duō tīng Zhōngwén gē.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Watch more Chinese TV, listen to more Chinese songs.

items.py: yībiān...yībiān...
items.en: while... at the same time...

items.py: chúle...yǐwài
items.en: besides; except

items.py: zhǐyào...jiù...
items.en: as long as... then...

items.py: suīrán...dànshì...
items.en: although... but...

items.en: to work hard; diligent

items.py: pà
items.en: to be afraid; to fear

items.en: indeed; really

items.en: important

items.py: Wǒ yībiān chī fàn yībiān kàn bào.
items.en: I read the newspaper while eating.

items.zh: 除了他以外，大家都去了。
items.py: Chúle tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu qù le.
items.en: Everyone went except him.

items.py: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù néng chénggōng.
items.en: As long as you work hard, you'll succeed.

items.zh: 虽然他很忙，但是每天都锻炼。
items.py: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì měi tiān dōu duànliàn.
items.en: Although he's busy, he exercises every day.

items.py: Yībiān zǒu yībiān liáo.
items.en: Chat while walking.

items.py: Yībiān hē chá yībiān kàn diànshì.
items.en: Watch TV while drinking tea.

items.zh: 除了汉语以外，她还会说日语。
items.py: Chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, tā hái huì shuō Rìyǔ.
items.en: Besides Chinese, she can also speak Japanese.

items.zh: 只要多练习，汉语就能说好。
items.py: Zhǐyào duō liànxí, Hànyǔ jiù néng shuō hǎo.
items.en: As long as you practice more, you'll speak Chinese well.

items.py: Suīrán lèi, dànshì hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Although tired, I'm happy.
